purpose: Diagnose overlapping filters, costs and exit churn, then compare a bounded set of mechanism changes. Do not reverse-engineer the original author or promote live qualification.

arm_definitions.reference: Exact prior selected configuration; unchanged engine and frozen inputs; summary and trade stream must match archived v1.
arm_definitions.exit_ma10_confirm2: Require two consecutive closes below MA10 before scheduling next-open trend exit. Intraday 7% hard stop remains immediate.
arm_definitions.exit_ma20: Replace the MA10 close exit with MA20; leave all other rules unchanged.
arm_definitions.exit_ma20_confirm2: Predeclared interaction: MA20 and two closes, immediate fixed hard stop unchanged.
arm_definitions.exit_ma50: Replace the MA10 close exit with MA50; slower research alternative, not claimed as original course rule.
arm_definitions.market_ma60: Add 0050 close above its last 60 valid close average to the existing market gate; entry only, no forced market exit.
arm_definitions.market_ma200: As above, 200 valid observations. Known ETF halt days cannot issue signals.
arm_definitions.market_ma200_exit_ma20: Predeclared interaction of the market MA200 entry gate and MA20 exit.
arm_definitions.first_signal_10: Only first eligible entry signal in the trailing 10 sessions per stock, regardless of whether earlier signals were executed.
arm_definitions.rank_momentum: Same candidate union, pure M ranking, removing institutional rank bonuses.
arm_definitions.rank_membership_count: Same candidate union, number of satisfied family flags first, M as tie-break. Explicitly tests naive more-is-better hypothesis.
arm_definitions.momentum_60: Use 60-session return and MA60 bias for momentum/trend instead of 20; amount ratio remains 20-session. Recompute all percentiles on the common fully known 60-session universe.
arm_definitions.institutions_delayed1: Sensitivity only: shift institutional availability by one trading session before feature construction; excluded from adaptive strategy selection.
arm_definitions.family_*: Keep a single family from the original signal union; same ranking, market, entry and exit. Family populations can overlap; comparisons are not randomized causal estimates.

invariants: Same liquidity threshold, actual turnover, five slots, 7% immediate hard stop, cash-only next-open fills, gap bounds, fee/tax/slippage and terminal-cost handling as parent. No global trading-account changes.
diagnostics: Pair recorded trades and exactly reconcile same-units gross price PnL, commissions, taxes, slippage and net PnL; this is attribution, not a frictionless reinvested account.
Report holding durations, entry market regime, exits, yearly losses and winning-trade concentration.
Count family overlap and leave-one-family-out candidate differences; detect constant ranking bonuses.

Measure 5- and 20-session next-open to horizon-close returns for eligible signals by score bucket and membership count, with same-period 0050 excess. State sample censoring and overlap; no calibrated future probabilities.
Report every arm, failed run and stress result; no unreported iterative parameter search.

walk_forward.selection: Expanding training ends the last trading day of the preceding year. From the 19 non-sensitivity arms require at least 20 closed trades and positive net CAGR; select max CAGR minus 0.5*absolute max drawdown, tie by name. If none passes, select cash. No next-year outcome is read by the selection function.
walk_forward.account: Each evaluation year starts with independent standard capital and ends net of estimated liquidation costs. Report year-by-year and compounded normalized research segments, explicitly not a continuous real settlement ledger.
walk_forward.label: Retrospective chronological replay on previously seen data; not a new untouched OOS test.

cost_stress: Re-run reference and the fixed market_ma200_exit_ma20 interaction with 0.3% slippage per side, without reselection; report both.
uncertainty: For all full-period arms, paired daily return differences against reference use fixed-seed circular block bootstrap, 20 sessions per block, 1000 replicates, 95% interval of annualized arithmetic mean difference. Intervals are descriptive and not adjusted for multiple testing; they do not establish causality or future profitability.
stopping_rule: Run the 20 predeclared arms and four annual selection rounds once; diagnosis can motivate later preregistered work, but do not extend the search after seeing these returns. All existing data/adjustment/publication/fill limitations remain.
